title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 5:33-37
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 5:33-37</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: The Messianic Torah (2024).
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="33" /> Again, <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">you have heard that it was said</char> to the ancients, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        “<char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">Do not</char> break your <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">oath</char>,”
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        and “Repay to the Lord your <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">vows</char>.”
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="34" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">And I tell you</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">do not swear an oath</char> at all: 
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">not</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">by the sky</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="3">
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="tan">because</char> it is God’s throne; 
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        <verse number="35" /> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">not</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">by the land</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="3">
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="tan">because</char> it is the stool of his feet; 
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">not</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">by Jerusalem</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="3">
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="tan">because</char> it is the city of the Great King. 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        <verse number="36" /> And <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">do not swear</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">by your head</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        for you cannot make even one hair white or black. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="37" /> But let your word be “Yes, yes” or “No, no”; 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        anything beyond this comes from the evil one. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
